title: LFM2.5-Encoders for Fast Long-Context Inference on CPU
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: LFM2.5-Encoders for Fast Long-Context Inference on CPU
body: LFM2.5-Encoders have been released to optimize long-context inference workloads on standard CPU hardware. By introducing sparse attention patterns and optimized matrix multiplication kernels, LFM2.5 reduces the CPU memory footprint for context lengths up to 128k tokens. This enables cost-effective document retrieval and analysis pipelines without relying on expensive GPU clusters. The encoders provide a drop-in replacement for standard model embeddings, delivering high performance and accuracy for enterprise document processing systems. This open-source release makes enterprise-grade inference highly accessible. This makes context-aware inference cost-effective for teams worldwide.
